title: Property location review
intro: Confirm genuine property locations and keep the public map honest. Coordinates from existing listings and imports stay unreviewed until an Admin checks their source. This tool does not guess locations or contact property owners.
summary_help: Summary cards use the selected listing status and search. A reviewed private location is not a public map pin. Existing area groups remain approximate.
search: Search title, recorded area or source reference
worksheet_help: Downloads missing-coordinate listings for the current listing status and search, with empty fields for a partner to supply. It contains no customer contacts or private evidence. It does not import or publish positions; review supplied locations before saving.
export_error: The worksheet could not be downloaded. Narrow your search or try again.
saved: Review saved. Public location fields now match the chosen privacy and review state.
use_destination: Use destination pair as a candidate
destination_help: Only an explicit destination pair can fill these fields. Viewport centers, city searches and unresolved short links are not used. This does not save or verify the position; check the property identity and source before confirming.
coordinate_help: Enter the actual property pair supplied by a reliable source. A city center or the /@ coordinates of a Maps viewport are not a property position. Both coordinates are required together.
source_help: Record what was checked and its date/reference. Explicit Maps destination review requires a destination pair that matches the entered coordinates. Links are validated without fetching or geocoding.
precision_help: Exact points publish only after a confirmed review. Area-only and no-map choices keep coordinates and the original source link private. Unreviewed/attention states remove the public point until confirmed.
confirmation: I checked this listing’s identity and confirmed that these coordinates belong to the actual property using the selected source.
projection_mismatch: The public projection differs from its review. Check the source and save a fresh review before relying on the point.
invalid: Check the coordinate pair, Maps link and source evidence. For a Maps destination, use the actual destination rather than a viewport.
verification_required: Reviewed locations require both coordinates, a source type, a source reference and your property confirmation.
conflict: This listing or review changed in another session. Reload it before saving.
save_unknown: The save could not be confirmed. Reload the current review before trying again.
